（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. 5 No. S. B. D. 70 . 31 Date Section 2 Station A）

REPORT
Date October 12, 19 31.

Subject (in full) Alleged smuggling of four students of Chinan University into Java.

Made by D.I.Kuh Paohwa Forwarded by A.B. Km a1.

With reference to the inquiry of October 5, 1931 from
the Netherlands Consulate-General, concerning the alleged
smuggling of four students of the Chinan University into
Java, I have to report that diligent inquiries made in
connection with this matter have, so far, failed to confirm
the information supplied by P.H. Pitterson. Discreet
inquiries among the students of the Chinan University
have also been unsuccessful.
Regarding P.H. Pitterson, this individual, who is
undoubtedly a shady character, left the Hung Fah (鸿发)
hotel, No. 111 Boulevard de Montigny on September 30, 1931
and since then his whereabouts have become obscure. Enquiries
among his friends in the various schools and at his usual
haunts have failed to disclose his present address.

Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Mr Yu, Please reply sending
a copy of the above report.
（签名）
13/10/'31

日期 1931年10月12日。

主题（全称） 涉嫌将四名暨南大学学生走私进入爪哇。

由 督察 顾宝华 制作 经由 A.B. Km a1 转呈。

关于荷兰总领事馆于1931年10月5日就涉嫌将四名暨南大学学生走私进入爪哇一事提出的查询，本人须报告称，就此事项进行的详尽调查迄今未能证实 P.H. Pitterson 所提供的信息。在暨南大学学生中进行的谨慎调查也未获成功。
关于 P.H. Pitterson，此人无疑是个品行不端之辈，他于1931年9月30日离开了蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）111号的鸿发酒店，此后其行踪不明。在其就读的各所学校及其常去场所向其朋友进行的查询，也未能查明其目前的住址。

顾宝华
督察

特别分部主管警官。

K.H. Pitterson.

K.H. Pitterson alias Sun Kheng Hoon alias Chu Wen
( 24 ), is a native of Menado, Celebes, Dutch East Indies.
He claims to be a musician by profession and also is
capable of singing and dancing. He speaks English rather
well and has a slight knowledge of Fukienese. His father
is said to be a merchant somewhere in Java, with branch
offices in Hongkong and Amoy and is reported to be wealthy.
Pitterson says he receives from his father a monthly remit-
tance varing from $200 to $500 which he spends in gambling
at the Canidrome.

I noticed more than thirty pawn tickets in his
possession, which were for musical instruments, a diamond
ring and a gramophone etc.

He is residing in Hung Fah Hotel (      ), No.111
Boulevard Montigny, room 19, but his telegraph address is
either 303 or 310 Rue Bourgeat for communication with his
father. He used to stay at his uncle's house, at No. 218
Avenue Foch, where he is keeping his clothes. He removed to
the hotel on account of restriction as his uncle insisted
that he be at home by 10 p.m. every night. His uncle does
not know that he is staying in the hotel, as he told him that
he lives in School, while to his father he wrote that he is
in hospital suffering from illness.

On 22.9.31 he received about $200 from his father on
the strength of his alleged sickness. Once he took me to
a pawnshop on Woosung Road, and after giving me some money, asked me
to redeem a pair of shoes, a velvet hat and a suit of clothes,
which had been pawned for $86. At the time I was redeeming
these things, he stood outside the shop, and
the master of the shop informed me that these articles had
been pawned by a tall Cantonese, not by a Pitterson.

K.H. Pitterson。

K.H. Pitterson，别名 Sun Kheng Hoon，别名 Chu Wen
（24岁），是荷属东印度西里伯斯岛万鸦老（Menado）人。他自称职业为音乐家，也能歌善舞。他的英语说得相当好，懂一点福建话。据说他的父亲是爪哇某地的商人，在香港和厦门设有分行，据报道家境富裕。Pitterson 称他每月从父亲那里收到200至500元不等的汇款，他都花在跑狗场的赌博上。

我发现他持有三十多张当票，典当物品包括乐器、钻戒和留声机等。

他居住在蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard Montigny）111号鸿发酒店（      ）19室，但他与其父亲联系的电报地址是布尔热瓦路（Rue Bourgeat）303号或310号。他过去住在福煦路218号他叔叔家，衣服也留在那里。由于受到限制，他搬到了酒店，因为他叔叔坚持要求他每晚10点前回家。他叔叔不知道他住在酒店，因为他告诉叔叔他住在学校，而给他父亲的信中则说他因病住院。

1931年9月22日，他凭借所谓的病情从父亲那里收到了约200美元。有一次他带我去吴淞路的一家当铺，给了我一些钱后，让我赎回一双鞋、一顶天鹅绒帽子和一套衣服，这些物品典当了86元。当我赎回这些东西时，他站在店外，店主告诉我这些物品是一个高个子广东人典当的，而不是 Pitterson。

他一拿到赎回的衣服就乘电车回到了酒店。
他说他在上海的舞厅、咖啡馆等地因多次打架而非常有名。
有一次我问他没有护照去爪哇的可能性，他告诉我他是如何帮助一些中国学生在没有护照的情况下到达爪哇的。
他通常将这类乘客安置在往返于上海和爪哇之间的荷兰轮船的厨房配膳室里，厨师会一直把他们留在那里，直到船进港。等待几个小时后，当一切安静下来，厨师便让他们上岸前往某个地址，伪装成船员成员。这种运输方式比买票旅行更便宜，他说他已经送走了四名暨南大学的学生。
他问我是否想去爪哇或厦门，因为他可以为我安排一切。

No. 1619
SHANGHAI, 13th April 1931

Sir,

Referring to my letter of the 8th instant, No. 1520,
I have the honour to enclose herewith translation of
a letter which I received from a certain Sieh Jih-kwan
(謝日光) concerning Sun Kheng-Hoen, the original
of which I kept in my archives.

I wonder whether the charge Sieh desires to bring
against Sun is made for the purpose of obtaining money
on the latter's behalf.

As Sum lost his Netherlands' nationality I have
answered Sieh to the effect that since Sum is not under
my jurisdiction, the Netherlands Consular Court is not
competent in this matter.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

pages.en:
COPIE
TRANSLATION.

From Sieh Jih-Kwan,
o/o Shanghai Law School.

10th May (1931).

Sir,
    I understand that Mr.Sun Kheng-hoen has some
monitary transactions with your Consulate. If
he should call again at your Consulate, I request
you to have him detained and handed over to the
Police.
    On the 6th of this month Mr.Sun called on me.
I went out for about 15 minutes, leaving Sun alone
in my room. When I cameback, Sun had left already
without leaving a word. One suit which had been hung
over the wall also disappeared, together with $ 30.-
in notes in the pockets. The total worth is about
$ 75.-.
    I shall feel obliged if you could tell me his
address.

Yours sincerely,
(sd.)SIEH JIH KWAN.
pages.zh:
副本
译文。

来自 谢日光，
上海法政学院。

1931年5月10日。

先生：
    据悉，Sun Kheng-hoen 先生与贵领事馆有一些金钱往来。如果他再次光顾贵领事馆，恳请将其扣留并移交警方。
    本月6日，Sun 先生拜访了我。我外出约15分钟，留 Sun 独自一人在我的房间里。当我回来时，Sun 已经离开，未留只言片语。挂在墙上的一套西装也不见了，连同口袋里的30元现金。总价值约为75元。
    如能告知其地址，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）谢日光。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1520.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. I. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2353
ate 11 - 5 - 31

SHANGHAI. 8th May 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Soei
Keng-hoen (孫慶雲) alias Sun Kheng-hoon alias Ch'ou
Wen (周文) alias K.H. Pitterson, born at Menado (Celebes,
N.E.I.) about 23 years of age, applied from time to time
to this Consulate General for financial assistance.

It appears that in stead of devoting himself to his
schoolwork he wasted his time and money on everything
but his studies.

In 1927 he obtained through the intermediary of this
Consulate General a substantial sum of money from his
father to pay his debts.

In 1928 further assistance was refused to him on
account of his misbehaviour in this office.

In the beginning of this year he approached the Con-
sulate again, telling all sorts of lies and asking again
for financial assistance from home.

It appears that during the greater part of last year
he lived at the Tung Nan Hotel, 563 North Szechuen Road,
leaving there an unpaid bill of more than $ 300.--. He
gave his Netherlands' passport to the manager by way of
security, stating to the Consulate that he had lost it.

His nerves seemed to be overstrained and he was and
still is in a very irritable state of mind.

This Consulate General advised his father, through the

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（左侧手写批注：）
* Sir,
No ground in
& p. bns. of c. v. s.
B. Reg.
11/5.

（左下角手写批注：）
oc. S. B.

刑事及特别分部登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2353
1931年5月11日收讫

上海，1931年5月8日。

先生：

谨此通知您，一位名叫 Soei Keng-hoen（孫慶雲），别名 Sun Kheng-hoon，别名 Ch'ou Wen（周文），别名 K.H. Pitterson 的人，出生于荷属东印度西里伯斯岛万鸦老（Menado），年龄约23岁，不时向本总领事馆申请经济援助。

看来他没有专心学业，而是将时间和金钱浪费在与学习无关的一切事务上。

1927年，他通过本总领事馆的中介，从父亲那里获得了一大笔钱以偿还债务。

1928年，由于他在本馆行为不端，拒绝向他提供进一步援助。

今年年初，他再次接触领事馆，编造各种谎言，再次请求家里提供经济援助。

看来去年大部分时间他住在北四川路563号的东南酒店，留下超过300元的未付账单。他将荷兰护照交给经理作为担保，却向领事馆声称护照遗失。

他的神经似乎过度紧张，当时且现在仍处于非常易怒的状态。

本总领事馆已通过

R. C. Alers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事及特别分部，
上海。

（左侧手写批注：）
* 先生，
刑事及特别分部登记处
档案中无依据。
5月11日。

（左下角手写批注：）
oc. 特别分部
RCM

pages.en:
- 2 -

the Netherlands' Indian authorities in Menado, that he
should not allow his son to stay any longer in Shanghai
without proper supervision and I am now requested to pay
his debt to the Tung Nan Hotel and to arrange for his
passage home.

During the first three months of this year Soei
omitted to repeat his registration with this Consulate
General as a Netherlands' subject so that the Immigration
Rules become applicable to him and enquiries have to be
made as to his antecedents.

I saw Soei for the last time on Saturday, when he
left in an angry mood because I did not want to give him
money except for his meals.

His last known address was c/o Cheng Ping-tan, 151
Wingon Lee, N.Szechuen Road. Before that he used to live
at 130 Boone Road and in the Honan Hotel, 460 North Honan
Road. A certain Lin Hoe-hai(林和海), student at Futan
University appears to have assisted Soei lately.

On the bill of the Tung Nan Hotel appeared one item
for bail money, advanced to obtain Soei's release from
custody at a Chinese Police Station, whence he had been
brought after a brawl with a constable. Otherwise I do
not know of any event which brought him in conflict with
the law although I would not be surprised to hear of his
entertaining relations with extremist students or being
addicted to narcotics. In case the Police have any infor-
mation concerning his activities I should be greatly obliged
to you for kindly informing me.

For identification purposes I enclose his photograph,
which kindly return to me again. It was taken from his old
passport, which I recovered in the meantime from the Tung Nan
Hotel and which has been withdrawn subsequently as Soei is
no longer a Netherlands' subject.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
pages.zh:
- 2 -

荷属东印度万鸦老当局建议其父亲，不应允许其子在无人适当监管的情况下继续留在上海，现在我受命偿还他在东南酒店的债务，并安排其回国的行程。

今年前三个月，Soei 未向本总领事馆重新登记其荷兰臣民身份，因此移民规则适用于他，必须对其背景进行调查。

我最后一次见到 Soei 是在星期六，当时他愤怒地离开，因为除了餐费外，我不愿给他钱。

他最后的已知地址是北四川路永吉里151号郑平丹（Cheng Ping-tan）转交。在此之前，他住在布恩路130号和河南路460号的河南酒店。复旦大学的一名学生林和海（Lin Hoe-hai）最近似乎协助过 Soei。

在东南酒店的账单上有一项保释金条目，是为从中国巡捕房释放 Soei 而预付的，他是因与一名巡捕斗殴后被带到那里的。除此之外，我不知道有任何事件使他陷入法律冲突，尽管如果听说他与激进学生有往来或吸食毒品，我也不会感到惊讶。如果警方掌握有关其活动的任何信息，恳请告知，我将不胜感激。

为了识别目的，随函附上他的照片，请阅后归还。这张照片取自他的旧护照，该护照我已从东南酒店收回，随后已被注销，因为 Soei 不再是荷兰臣民。

顺致
崇高的敬意，

您的恭顺仆人，
